t: You're standing by the Limehouse War Memorial, in the churchyard of St Anne's. It was made by Arthur George Walker, an English sculptor and painter who worked on a number of war memorials. He is also known for the statue of Florence Nightingale in Waterloo Place, which you can find elsewhere in London. Here, his skill is turned to remembering the war dead of this corner of the East End, in the grounds of the church.
